(5)  Any  person  who  contravenes  an  order  made,  to  be
applicable  to  a  specified  person  under  paragraph  (b)  of
subsection (3) of this section without a reasonable excuse,
commits  an  offence  and  shall  on  conviction  by  the  High
Court be liable to a fine not exceeding one million rupees or
to a term of imprisonment not exceeding seven years or to
both such fine and imprisonment.
